messages.author: fbfd20ce829c6c6c
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] GPA result show the different shape from the original data
parts:
Hi there, 

Given your two original images of the femur "61 Ks" and "2 Ks", it seems you are expecting these two to look about the same. 

However, the original individual data will not look the same after GPA. This is because you included semilandmarks in your analysis, these will slide to a certain degree depending on the variation of all of your other individual samples, to minimize some criterion like Procrustes distance or bending energy. You seemed to have used the default option for the ProcD= argument in gpagen meaning you are currently sliding semilandmarks to minimize bending energy. 

You might also be wondering why 61 Ks looks like an impossible femur shape (assuming the landmarks and semilandmarks were placed on the outline of the femur, judging by your original data). This is may be due to the semilandmarks but could be influenced by many aspects of data collection and analysis. Rather than potentially misleading you on this front, I will defer to more experienced folks who can provide better feedback.

Best,
Bryan
